sentences.text: The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Shushma.

The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused married CW-1 on 04-04-2021 and after the marriage he had subjected CW1 to mental and physical cruelty by quarreling with her for petty matters, abusing her I filthy language, assaulting her, harassing her to get Rs.30 lakhs or to leave the home.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.589/2023 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Girinagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

The plea of the accused was recorded.

sentences.text: There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and  5  C.C.No.325/2024 also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
